name: AWS IoT nodes are disabled until configured
info: Configure the AWS IoT endpoint, certificate, private key, and root CA, then enable the AWS IoT MQTT out nodes for the final cloud demonstration. Use cps/analysis/risk for full risk telemetry and cps/alerts/risk_state for SNS-style state-change notifications.
